title: GenForge parts-sheet manifest
description: Maps named parts of a single generated parts-sheet PNG to sheet regions. rect is [x,y,w,h] in sheet pixels; pivot is [px,py] in pixels LOCAL to the rect (the bone attachment point); angle_hint is the angle in degrees (clockwise-positive, y-down) the part is pre-drawn at on the sheet — the baker subtracts it before applying bone rotation.

sheet.description: Path of the parts-sheet PNG, relative to this manifest file

rect.description: [x, y, w, h] on the sheet, pixels

pivot.description: [px, py] attachment point, pixels, local to rect

angle_hint.description: Degrees (cw-positive) the part is pre-drawn at
